'''''Fortune's Favor''''' was a [[Wayfarer-class medium freighter/Legends|''Wayfarer''-class medium freighter]] that was owned by the [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''Fortune's Favor'' made features in ''[[Belted In: Incursion|Incursion]]'', an adventure in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign, where Nirama can lend it to the player characters if they don't have a ship of their own. If they choose to borrow it, then they can also use it in the subsequent adventure, ''[[Belted In: Excursion|Excursion]]''.
